plans.title: Subscription plans
plans.description: What the platform sells: each plan's price, what it includes, and why it is worth choosing.
plans.emptyDescription: Create a plan and it will appear here, and on the subscription screen of every company.

dialog.createDescription: Set the name, the price, what the plan includes and what makes it worth choosing — all in one place.
dialog.viewDescription: Everything this plan offers, as it will be shown to companies.

form.name: Plan name
form.nameHint: What the customer sees, for example "Standard" or "Premium".
form.codeHintCreate: Generated from the name. This is the code stored on every company subscribed to the plan.
form.codeHintEdit: Fixed. Changing it would break the link for every company already on this plan.
form.descriptionHint: One line on who the plan is for. Shown under the price.
form.priceHint: The amount charged per billing period. Enter 0 for a free plan.
form.featuresDescription: One row per thing the plan covers. Comparing these rows is how customers tell the plans apart, so give every plan the same features — untick the ones it does not include rather than leaving them out.
form.benefitsDescription: The selling points, as short statements. Shown as a list on the plan, not compared across plans.
form.activeHint: Turn this off to retire the plan: it can no longer be chosen by a new company, but the companies already on it keep it.
form.displayOrderHint: Where this plan sits in the list — lowest first. Leave blank for the end.
form.allowsDescription: Enforced by the server. Reaching a limit only stops adding more; nothing existing is locked.
form.limitInvalid: A whole number of at least 1, or blank.
form.coreAlwaysIncluded: Purchases, stock, partners, cocoa price, till, payments and receipts are in every plan. A module left out is read-only for companies on this plan.
form.frenchDescription: Shown to French-speaking readers. Leave a field blank to show the English text instead.

benefits.placeholder: For example: unlimited purchases and payments

detail.noFeatures: This plan has no features listed yet.
detail.noBenefits: This plan has no benefits listed yet.

compare.heading: Plans side by side
compare.description: Every plan and what it covers, aligned row by row, so the difference is visible rather than something to work out.
compare.noFeatures: No plan has features listed yet, so there is nothing to compare.

mine.heading: What your plan includes
mine.description: The plan this company is subscribed to, and how it compares with the others on offer.
mine.noCatalogue: The plan catalogue is empty, so there is nothing to describe your plan with. Your subscription itself is unaffected.
mine.unknownPlan: This company is on plan "{{code}}", which is not in the catalogue any more. Its subscription is unaffected, but there is no description to show.
